facts.statement: The type species of the genus Paraortygoides is Paraortygoides messelensis.
A second species, Paraortygoides argillae, was described by Mayr and Kitchener in 2024.
facts.quote: subdivision: Paraortygoides argillae Mayr and Kitchener, 2024

facts.statement: Paraortygoides is an extinct genus of bird belonging to the family Gallinuloididae.
facts.quote: Paraortygoides is an extinct genus of gallinuloidid bird

facts.statement: This bird lived in Europe during the Ypresian and Lutetian stages of the Eocene epoch.
facts.quote: lived in what is now Europe during the Ypresian and Lutetian stages of the Eocene epoch

facts.statement: Fossils of the type species Paraortygoides messelensis have been found in the Messel Formation of Germany.
facts.quote: The type species, Paraortygoides messelensis, is known from the Messel Formation of Germany

facts.statement: The species Paraortygoides argillae occurred in the Walton Member of the London Clay Formation in England.
facts.quote: Another species, Paraortygoides argillae, occurred in the Walton Member of the London Clay Formation of England

facts.statement: The Paleobi Database classifies Paraortygoides under the class Reptilia.
The time range for Paraortygoides is recorded as the Ypresian stage, between 56 and 48.07 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Ypresian to Ypresian (56 to 48.07 million years ago)
